metadata.notes: Insider trading data was non-informative across all 20 cases (0 buys, 0 sells, mixed direction in every case). Customer concentration data was unavailable for all cases. Management/proxy data provided marginal signal in 2 cases (WFRD and WEX) where executive changes coincided with deteriorating financials. Several cases show apparent revenue declines that may reflect annual-vs-quarterly reporting artifacts rather than true deterioration (NEU, WEX, LOPE, GNTX, THO, VVV). No classification changes occurred between baseline and enriched assessments due to uniformly thin enrichment data.
